meta.scope: Myanmar Batch 2 — Agriculture (rice), natural gas / extractives, and China trade corridor densification under constrained data conditions.

candidates.title: Agriculture production statistics
candidates.description: Official and compiled statistics on crop and livestock production. Agriculture remains a large share of employment and rural livelihoods; rice is the dominant staple and a material export crop.
candidates.notes: Core primary-sector production node. Data coverage is incomplete relative to pre-2021 benchmarks.

candidates.title: Rice production and area statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from CSO and remote-sensing / agricultural monitoring sources
candidates.description: Statistics and estimates on rice cultivation area and production. Ayeyarwady and other delta/lowland regions are central; production levels interact with climate, conflict and input constraints.
candidates.notes: Foundational food-security crop node under constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Natural gas production and export statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from trade and energy sources
candidates.description: Statistics on natural gas production and exports. Petroleum gas is among Myanmar’s largest export commodities by value; primary destinations include Thailand and China.

candidates.title: Myanmar–China merchandise trade statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from Chinese customs and related sources
candidates.description: Bilateral trade with China. China is a dominant trade partner; Myanmar exports include ores, mineral fuels, rubber, copper and agricultural products; imports include vehicles, machinery, electrical equipment and fabrics. Border and informal flows are material.
candidates.notes: Primary bilateral trade corridor under constrained official data.

candidates.title: Myanmar agriculture–extractives–China densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from agricultural, energy and trade sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding agriculture and rice statistics, natural gas production/exports, and Myanmar–China trade into a coherent primary-sector, extractives and external layer under constrained data conditions.
